XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS Calendar Sync — outbound ICS feed token storage (Tier 2.6 Phase 1)

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_calendar_token
TABLE.COMMENT:
Tier 2.6 Phase 1 (2026-05-24) — One row per user per active ICS subscription token. The token is a 64-character random string embedded in the subscription URL the user pastes into Outlook / Google / Apple Calendar. The token is the authentication mechanism — calendar clients fetch the feed without browser cookies, so cookie-based session auth is not available.
A user may have at most one ACTIVE (revoked=0) token at a time; regenerate revokes the old one and creates a new one. Revoked rows are kept for audit (we can answer 'who used a leaked token, when?'). Periodic cleanup deletes revoked rows older than 90 days via the purge_old_tokens scheduled task.
Multi-customer scope: each row carries customerid + tenantid so future per-customer reporting can answer 'how many users in Customer N have subscribed?'.
GDPR / privacy: the token alone does not identify the user to an outside party. last_used_at + last_used_ip are useful for abuse forensics; both purge with the row after 90-day retention.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id — the user whose calendar this token unlocks

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay) per customer::current().

FIELD.NAME: tenantid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA). Derived from user open_path at insert time.

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: 64-char URL-safe random token (alphanumeric). Used as the URL query parameter that authenticates the request.

FIELD.NAME: revoked
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = active, 1 = revoked (user regenerated). Revoked tokens never authenticate again.

FIELD.NAME: last_used_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts of last successful feed fetch (NULL = never used)

FIELD.NAME: last_used_ip
FIELD.COMMENT: IPv4 / IPv6 of the last fetch. Diagnostic only.

FIELD.NAME: use_count
FIELD.COMMENT: Total successful fetch count. Helps identify abandoned subscriptions.

KEY.NAME: uk_token
KEY.COMMENT: Token alone authenticates — must be globally unique

INDEX.NAME: idx_user_revoked
INDEX.COMMENT: Lookup current active token for a user

INDEX.NAME: idx_timemodified
INDEX.COMMENT: Purge query for revoked rows older than retention window
